svg.title: Matchcut: Azure architecture (component and deployment view)
svg.desc: Matchcut runs in one Azure resource group: Container Apps for the simulator, TV renderer, vision, insights, recap, API and League Memory MCP server; Container Apps Jobs for rendering and QA; Event Hubs, Storage, Azure SQL, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Speech and Translator; managed identity; Application Insights. GitHub Actions deploys with OIDC.

text.style: font:700 26px 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
font:400 14px 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

svg.text: Main flow · kick-off to every fan's cut

text.style: font:400 12.5px 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

svg.text: 1 sim publishes match events + 10 Hz tracking (AMQP)

text.style: font:400 12.5px 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

svg.text: 2 renderer consumes tracking, draws the TV feed

svg.text: 3 renderer writes HLS segments to Blob
